sessions.summary: v0.9.0: Mi cuenta page (password change direct or via email confirmation link), /reset-password recovery page, security recommendation banner, Sidebar link. Fixed create-agent 401 (anon key → user JWT). Ported WhatsApp gateway to wa-gateway Edge Function and deployed it plus create-agent to Supabase. whatsapp-gateway/ marked deprecated (R5). | v0.9.1: root-caused production 406s — asistente_real_state schema was not exposed to PostgREST and anon/authenticated lacked USAGE/table grants; fixed via migration (grants + pgrst.db_schemas + reload). Added dark mode (tokens, sidebar toggle, card/modal theming) and improved sidebar text contrast. | v0.9.2: production UI rendered unstyled — postcss.config.js was missing so Next.js never ran Tailwind (raw @tailwind/@apply shipped to browser; only native @layer CSS vars worked). Added config, verified compiled CSS contains utilities/preflight/dark tokens. | Storage uploads returned 400: storage.objects had INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies but no SELECT policy, and uploads do INSERT..RETURNING. Added app_buckets_select policy (live in prod), recorded as db/migrations/07. Also reloaded PostgREST schema cache (406→404→fixed). | v0.9.3: WhatsApp page agent selector changed from free-text UUID to dropdown. wa-gateway reads WA_ANON_KEY secret (legacy anon key disabled in project; new publishable key sb_publishable_PVLt...). Supabase MCP deploy blocked (approval never reaches chat) — user deployed wa-gateway via dashboard editor, /health returns ok. Meta webhook NOT configured yet: plan is POST subscribed_apps with override_callback_uri (Meta docs API Playground) using verify_token wa-gateway-rs-2026-k8x4m7q; blocked at session end by Facebook outage (queued PS-001). graph.facebook.com also blocked by Claude env network policy — user was adding it to allowlist so Claude can run the call with user-provided temp token + WABA ID.
commits: feat(security+wa): password change w/ email confirmation, wa-gateway edge function
fix(api)+feat(ui): expose schema in Data API, dark mode
fix(build): add postcss.config.js so Tailwind compiles
fix(db): add SELECT policy on storage.objects so uploads pass RLS
fix(whatsapp): select agent from dropdown instead of free-text UUID
fix(wa-gateway): allow overriding anon key via WA_ANON_KEY
